title: Zero-sized suffix
spec: Implement recent(items, limit). Return a new list containing at most the last limit items, in input order. limit is a non-negative integer. Zero returns an empty list. Do not modify items.
target_defect: A zero limit returns the entire input because -0 is zero in the slice.
author_rationale: The change simplifies suffix selection while retaining the input ordering.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
